title: AnchorHistoryLine
description: One line of anchors.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): an anchor added, moved or removed, sampled with each mesh snapshot and at stop. Updates only for anchors that moved more than about 1 mm or 0.05 degrees since their last line. Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: t never decreases, transform is null exactly for remove, and frame is set exactly for keyframe anchors.

transform.description: Anchor to world, or null for remove.

frame.description: The keyframe's frame for a keyframe anchor, else null.

kind.title: AnchorHistoryKind
kind.description: keyframe: the anchor placed at a keyframe. image: a detected image anchor. mesh: a mesh anchor. marked: an anchor markAnchor placed.
